structured.feedback: The "Pierce or Wear" section overpromises by presenting the self-piercing cartridge as a reliable way to get a new piercing, even though reviews report upside-down cartridges, crooked and painful piercings, and a spring that didn't release; the "Gentle on Sensitive Ears" claim of comfort also conflicts with the reported pain. The copy also doesn't clearly separate features from benefits as the prompt requires. Length (~190 words), active voice, subheadings, and the call to action are otherwise fine.
